translation.src_text: Special Olympics USA se ekip nasyonal la ki reprezante Etazini yo nan Special Olympics Mondyal pandan ete ak ivè jwèt yo. Delegasyon an gen ladan tou Special Olympics unified sports team, kote moun ki gen ak san yo pa gen andikap entelektyèl konpetisyon ansanm, kòm koekipye.
translation.tgt_text: Special Olympics USA is the national team that represents the United States at the Special Olympics World Summer and Winter Games. The 210-member delegation is comprised of 150 athletes, 40 coaches, and approximately 20 delegation members who support team operations. The delegation also includes Special Olympics Unified Sports teams, where people with and without intellectual disabilities compete together, as teammates.
